Coverage of the repair is real, not self-reported: candidates-final mtime 14:06:34, blind/ and distractor/ sheets rebuilt 14:09:58 and both contain 'byggnadsminnesförklaras', and verdicts-vfinal G-KEY-regate0726 (x2 votes x2 questions, all pass, solver answers C and A) plus G-DISTRACTOR-regate0726 (both questions pass) were written 14:11-14:12. The clearing verdict CORRECTED is now backed by the artifact.

findings.claim: The integrated sweep's own responsibilities re-verify clean under an adversarial pass on the repaired file, including the newly rewritten rationale clause.
findings.evidence: All five single-quoted rationale phrases resolve VERBATIM against the current text: 'oftare fel' and 'Den räcker inte' in the passage; 'alltid rätt' (q1 B), 'främst' (q2 A) and 'inte längre någon praktisk uppgift' (q2 C) in the option set. Arithmetic reconciles: 96 inventoried / 32 still correct / 27 at ferry-berth, bus-station, schoolyard or factory-gate sites, and the rationale's 'Fem av de fungerande uren stod dessutom någon annanstans' = 32-27 = 5, which also accommodates p5's 'Ett par av de välskötta uren ... vid torg utan någon avgång alls' (2 <= 5). Paragraph citations are accurate on the shipping text (numbers p2, mechanism p3, sawmill whistle p4, caveat p5, thesis p6; the byline rides on p6 and the glossary is the trailing block). No cross-question leak. Key is not the longest option in either item (q1: A 133 chars > C 120; q2: D 132 > A 122), matching the generator_meta self_blind_solve claim. planted_traps, question_families and key_spread ['C','A'] all match the item bodies. Key sanity holds: q1 C is protected by 'snarare än' against the 5-of-32 residue and the dropped 'fabriksgrind' site, q2 A by 'främst' against the p5 well-kept-square-clock caveat; every distractor is refutable from the passage (q1 A inverts p2's outcome, q1 B absolutises past 'oftare fel', q1 D contradicts 'visslan ersatte aldrig uret' and the sixties dating, q2 B contradicts 'värda att laga', q2 C is the explanation p4 rejects, q2 D inverts the causal order). The final-file rewrite of the q1 WHY-NOT-B clause is an improvement, not a regression: the corrected-stage wording ('den anger tjugosju av trettiotvå - alltså inte heller alltid rätt vid avgångsplatserna') was a non sequitur, and the shipping wording now states correctly that '27 of 32 says where the working clocks stood, not what share of the clocks at departure points ran right - texten räknar aldrig den vägen'.
findings.why: Recorded so the CONFIRMED_NOTES verdict rests on positive re-verification of the whole unit, not only on the absence of the previously named defect.

findings.claim: Both open G-STEM `major` flags on this unit (q:1 and q:2) are still undispositioned: no review record anywhere names them, and batch9 has no ADJUDICATION.md, so the flags the G-STEM contract routes to adjudication have no landing place yet.
findings.evidence: verdicts.jsonl: G-STEM q:1 verdict flag, severity major, note 'PARTIALLY: B is the absolute-overclaim twin of C (alltid, varje) and falls out on form; D reports an unrelated interwar finding and is off-frame ... That leaves A and C as direct mirrors, a 50/50'; G-STEM q:2 verdict flag, severity major, note 'PARTIALLY: ... A is the only thesis-shaped option left, so the blind lean is strong. Flagged rather than killed'. reviews/pedagogy.jsonl records {verdict: MINOR_FIXES} for this unit with no note; the integrated post-repair line carries only 'post-repair sweep'; the language note is scoped to lexis. gates/prompts/G-STEM.md: 'WORLD_KNOWLEDGE or PARTIALLY -> flag (severity major) - survives ... routed to adjudication'. Contrast the sibling unit in the same batch: reviews/pedagogy.jsonl las-b9-002 explicitly re-records 'G-STEM PARTIALLY/WORLD_KNOWLEDGE on q:1 adjudicated UPHELD (never dispositioned in either prior review)'. No such record exists for las-b9-003.
findings.why: Minor, not verdict-changing. I reproduced the blind read myself and the flags are correctly classified PARTIALLY rather than WORLD_KNOWLEDGE: on q:1 blind elimination leaves a genuine A-vs-C 50/50 that only the passage decides, and on q:2 the thesis-shaped lean is the profile authentic 'överensstämmer bäst' items also have. BATCH-RUNBOOK.md also puts flag disposition at stage 11/12 (ADJUDICATION.md + owner), which batch9 has not reached, so this is a pending step rather than a stage failure. It is recorded because the batch's own precedent (las-b9-002) treats an undispositioned G-STEM major as something a review stage must name, and consistency within the batch matters for the owner spot-check.

findings.claim: The shipping metadata's hedge-balance defence is imprecise on q:1: it calls the key the plain, confident option and the distractor the measured-sounding one, but the key carries its own hedge.
findings.evidence: generator_meta.self_blind_solve: 'Hedge balance: Q1 key C is a plain, confident locational claim while distractor A is the measured-sounding one (oftare), so the qualified option is wrong there'. But q1 C reads '... stod vid färjelägen, busstationer och skolgårdar SNARARE ÄN på kyrktorn och bankfasader' - a comparative hedge, and the very hedge the same audit trail relies on to protect C against the 5-of-32 residue. So q1 has two hedged options (A 'oftare', C 'snarare än'), one absolutised (B 'alltid/varje') and one plain (D).
findings.why: The conclusion the metadata draws still holds - a most-qualified-option heuristic does not select the key on q:1 (it cannot separate A from C) while it does on q:2 ('främst'), so the hedge-key correlation is not exploitable across the unit. Only the stated reason is wrong. Same class as the las-b9-001 finding on a rewritten hedge-balance defence; student-invisible, so minor.

findings.claim: Carry-over from the previous audit, still unfixed and still unrecorded: the trap label 'reversed_causality' on q:1 option A names an inversion of an empirical association, not a causal flip.
findings.evidence: q1 option A: 'De mest påkostade uren visade sig vara de bäst underhållna, medan enklare ur vid hållplatser och skolgårdar oftare hade stannat helt.' - no causal connective; the causality is supplied by the rationale itself ('så att pengar och prakt får förklara underhållet'). Compare q2 D, a genuine arrow flip: 'Uren stannade därför att kommunerna slutade underhålla dem, vilket i sin tur fick verksamheterna att överge sina fasta avgångstider.' The repair pass left both generator_meta.planted_traps['1']['A'] and the rationale label unchanged and recorded no disposition for the earlier note.
findings.why: Still admissible under the repo's own taxonomy - las/blueprint-template.md defines reversed_causality as 'flip the arrow / swap subject<->object of the target claim', and A does swap the two categories' outcomes - so this is not verdict-changing and an edit is optional. Repeated only so the note is not silently dropped between audits; the equivalent mislabel in las-b9-002 was likewise carried as minor.
